title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
variant: Bounded test of claims (1)+(2): response-only vs single-adapter reasoning LoRA, matched items/N/epochs/lr; Banking77 in-domain + MMLU retention
model_rationale: Paper's exact model (Qwen3-8B); proven T4 QLoRA carrier (ToolSelect verify3/verify5, AOPD run f, MCPO arm 1). Qwen3.5-9B probe GREEN 2026-10-30 but full trainer OOM'd; no 9B arm required -- claim is about Qwen3-8B.
teacher: Base model itself (Qwen3-8B), few-shot greedy, rejection-sampled on gold label. NOT an external larger teacher as in the paper -- recorded limitation.
